reason: The second fleet: boost, stable-forest and vote at once (live/madelon-fleet2-*) for up to an hour, with capture telling an agent when its siblings had found something since it last read the map. Every trail checks. compact is reached, twice, each by a design locked on pilot data and scored on the held-out file once: vote at step-26, a top-20 F screen and a soft vote of a random forest and Manhattan k-nearest neighbours, holdout_auc 0.719 with cv_auc 0.73 and 20 features; stable-forest at step-59, a 10-feature screen kept across bootstrap resamples and a tuned forest, holdout_auc 0.7125 with cv_auc 0.7506. screen is reached three times, on pilot data alone: vote step-22, stable-forest step-56, boost step-25. boost stopped at the wall clock before its one held-out score. The agents built on each other as they ran: boost's plans at step-15, step-23 and step-29 build on vote's step-22 and stable-forest's steps 56 and 59, and stable-forest's step-57 builds on vote's step-22. vote and stable-forest also built on the first fleet's trails of their own routes. Each credit excuses one captured read, stated in the resolution: every agent counted the rows of data/heldout.csv while looking around, before any design. This is a judgment, made here; the trace shows the read, and check accepts it only because this revision names it and says why. Two disclosures. First, project_map told stable-forest at 15:30 UTC, before it locked its screen (step-54), that vote had provisionally met compact-vote; the number was withheld but the fact is held-out information. Capture now leaves such results out of what an agent is shown. stable-forest's design came from its own pilot search, so it is credited, with this stated. Second, the agents read outside their workspaces: vote copied the first fleet's vote_lib.py and stable-forest read the first fleet's vote workspace and outputs. The first fleet scored nothing on the held-out file. A search of every command in the three sessions finds no read of the key, the Pi configuration, or a second-fleet sibling's workspace. Agents are not sandboxed; that remains a limit.
